exposure: number of abnormal values of oral 75 g glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: The study included 3545 pregnant women with twin pregnancies who underwent an oral 75 g glucose tolerance test in Women's and Children's Hospital of Chongqing Medical University.
finding: The number of abnormal OGTT values was significantly associated with an increased incidence of gestational hypertension and intrahepatic cholestasis in twin pregnancies, particularly those conceived via assisted reproduction.
